Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The "lady" eventually introduced herself to Bernadette as the Immaculate Conception, which had been proclaimed as a dogma for the Virgin Mary by Pope Pius IX in 1854.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: This convinced local priest _____ that Bernadette saw an authentic apparition of the Virgin Mary
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: This convinced local priest Dominique Peyramale that Bernadette saw an authentic apparition of the Virgin Mary.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Local priest _____ and local bishop Bertrand-Sévère Laurence bought the grotto and the land around it from the town of Lourdes in 1861, three years after the apparitions
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: This convinced local priest Dominique Peyramale that Bernadette saw an authentic apparition of the Virgin Mary.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: During the apparitions, _____ was given instructions by the "lady", which were to prove central in the development of the sanctuary and its ceremonies
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: From 11 February to 16 July 1858, Bernadette saw the same vision 18 times. The "lady" eventually introduced herself to Bernadette as the Immaculate Conception, which had been proclaimed as a dogma for the Virgin Mary by Pope Pius IX in 1854.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Local priest Dominique Peyramale and local bishop Bertrand-Sévère Laurence bought the grotto and the land around it from the town of Lourdes in _____, three years after the apparitions
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Bernadette ignored their orders and kept going to the grotto. From 11 February to 16 July 1858, Bernadette saw the same vision 18 times.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Immediately they set about modifying the area to make it more accessible to pilgrims, and started work to build the first of the churches, which is now known as the "_____"
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Immediately they set about modifying the area to make it more accessible to pilgrims, and started work to build the first of the churches, which is now called the "Crypt".

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: In _____, the French sculptor Joseph-Hugues Fabisch was commissioned to create a statue of Our Lady of Lourdes based on Bernadette's descriptions
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: In 1864, the French sculptor Joseph-Hugues Fabisch was commissioned to create a statue of Our Lady of Lourdes based on Bernadette's descriptions.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The statue rests in the niche where the Virgin appeared to _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: In 1864, the French sculptor Joseph-Hugues Fabisch was commissioned to create a statue of Our Lady of Lourdes based on Bernadette's descriptions. Although it has become an iconic symbol of Our Lady of Lourdes, it depicts a figure which is not only older and taller than Bernadette's description, but also more in keeping with orthodox and traditional representations of the Virgin Mary.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Due to French political upheaval resulting in an enforced separation of Church and State, the property and grounds of the sanctuary were confiscated from the Church and returned to the ownership of th
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Due to French political upheaval resulting in an enforced separation of Church and State, the property and grounds of the sanctuary were confiscated from the Church and returned to the ownership of the town in 1910.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The then bishop, François-Xavier Schoepfer, contested this confiscation and was permitted to rent the area of the sanctuary from the town until the outbreak of World War I in _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The then bishop, François-Xavier Schoepfer, contested this confiscation and was permitted to rent the area of the sanctuary from the town until the outbreak of World War I in 1914.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The then bishop, François-_____, contested this confiscation and was permitted to rent the area of the sanctuary from the town until the outbreak of World War I in 1914
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The then bishop, François-Xavier Schoepfer, contested this confiscation and was permitted to rent the area of the sanctuary from the town until the outbreak of World War I in 1914.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Later, a visit to Lourdes by Marshal Pétain in _____ provided official recognition of the sanctuary
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Later, a visit to Lourdes by Marshal Pétain in 1941 provided official recognition of the sanctuary.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The sanctuary is run independently of the parish of Lourdes, which is responsible for the spiritual needs of the _____ themselves
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The sanctuary is run independently of the parish of Lourdes, which is responsible for the spiritual needs of the Lourdais themselves.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: As of _____ there were 292 full-time lay employees and a further 120 seasonal employees working in 63 different divisions, with an annual running budget of €18 million, 90% from donations
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: As of 2010 there were 292 full-time lay employees and a further 120 seasonal employees working in 63 different divisions, with an annual running budget of €18 million, 90% from donations.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: As of 2010 there were 292 full-time lay employees and a further 120 seasonal employees working in 63 different divisions, with an annual running budget of €_____, 90% from donations
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: As of 2010 there were 292 full-time lay employees and a further 120 seasonal employees working in 63 different divisions, with an annual running budget of €18 million, 90% from donations.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The winter season runs from 1 November (the feast of _____) until Easter
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The winter season runs from 1 November (the feast of All Saints) until Easter. The sanctuary is fully active between Easter and All Saints' Day each year, and has a programme of devotional activities including Mass, processions, adoration of the Blessed Sacrament, and the sacrament of reconciliation.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: On 11 _____, the Feast of Our Lady of Lourdes, a full programme of activities usually takes place
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: On 11 February, the Feast of Our Lady of Lourdes, a full programme of activities usually takes place.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The grounds are open daily from 5 am until midnight; outside these times the grotto is accessible via the _____ behind the Upper Basilica
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The grounds are open daily from 5 am until midnight; outside these times the grotto is accessible via the Lacets Gate behind the Upper Basilica.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: An estimated 200 million people have visited the shrine since _____, including those who attend as members of pilgrimages organised on a national or diocesan basis
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: An estimated 200 million people have visited the shrine since 1860, including those who attend as members of pilgrimages organised on a national or diocesan basis.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: An estimated _____ people have visited the shrine since 1860, including those who attend as members of pilgrimages organised on a national or diocesan basis
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: An estimated 200 million people have visited the shrine since 1860, including those who attend as members of pilgrimages organised on a national or diocesan basis.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The first _____ diocesan pilgrimages were from Liverpool, Salford and Leeds in the 1920s
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The first English diocesan pilgrimages were from Liverpool, Salford and Leeds in the 1920s.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The first pilgrimage to arrive in Lourdes by plane took place in _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The first pilgrimage to arrive in Lourdes by plane took place in 1948.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The Roman Catholic Church has officially recognized 72 miraculous healings, the latest of which was the cure of Antonietta Raco, recognised on 16 April _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The Roman Catholic Church has officially recognized 72 miraculous healings, the latest of which was the cure of Antonietta Raco, recognised on 16 April 2025.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The water from Lourdes was thoroughly analysed by independent chemists in _____ and 1859, and does not appear to have a latent power to cure and has no special scientific or medicinal properties, havi
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The water from Lourdes was thoroughly analysed by independent chemists in 1858 and 1859, and does not appear to have a latent power to cure and has no special scientific or medicinal properties, having been described as a placebo.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Typically the bearer of the _____ is sheltered by a baldachin
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The procession begins at the open-air altar on the prairie across the river from the grotto and is led by sick pilgrims followed by a priest, bishop or cardinal carrying a monstrance containing the Blessed Sacrament. Typically the bearer of the Blessed Sacrament is sheltered by a baldachin.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: A representative group of doctors from the various pilgrimages follow directly behind the _____, both during the procession and the Blessing of the sick
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Typically the bearer of the Blessed Sacrament is sheltered by a baldachin. The Blessed Sacrament is accompanied by candle bearers and incense burners.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The procession makes its way across the river, past the _____, along the esplanade and down into the St
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The procession makes its way across the river, past the Crowned Virgin, along the esplanade and down into the St.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: When all the participants are assembled, there is a period of _____ adoration, followed by the Blessing of the Sick
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: When all the participants are assembled, there is a period of Eucharistic adoration, followed by the Blessing of the Sick.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: It begins near the grotto and continues in the alleys of the esplanade ending in the _____ square
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: It begins near the grotto and continues in the alleys of the esplanade ending in the Rosary square.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: In extreme weather an indoor ceremony may be held in the _____ instead
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: In extreme weather an indoor ceremony may be held in the Underground Basilica instead.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The procession is led by sick and disabled pilgrims followed by volunteers carrying a replica of the Cabuchet statue of the _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The procession is led by sick and disabled pilgrims followed by volunteers carrying a replica of the Cabuchet statue of the Virgin Mary.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Intercessions may be invoked followed by the _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Intercessions may be invoked followed by the Laudate Mariam.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: There is a final blessing in _____, and then an invitation to exchange the sign of peace with fellow pilgrims
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: There is a final blessing in Latin, and then an invitation to exchange the sign of peace with fellow pilgrims.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The walls are lined with ex voto plaques, and banners from official _____ of the past
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The walls are lined with ex voto plaques, and banners from official National Pilgrimages of the past.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: It has a series of stained-glass windows depicting various events in the story of Lourdes; the clerestory windows depict Mary as "the _____"
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: It has a series of stained-glass windows depicting various events in the story of Lourdes; the clerestory windows depict Mary as "the Second Eve".

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The exterior is dominated by a 70 m (230 ft) spire, and two lesser spires completed later in _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The exterior is dominated by a 70 m (230 ft) spire, and two lesser spires completed later in 1908.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The exterior is dominated by a _____ (230 ft) spire, and two lesser spires completed later in 1908
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The exterior is dominated by a 70 m (230 ft) spire, and two lesser spires completed later in 1908.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The basilica has a crypt, which was the first church to be completed in the sanctuary, in _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The basilica has a crypt, which was the first church to be completed in the sanctuary, in 1866. Bernadette's father worked on its construction and was present at its official opening, on Pentecost Sunday 1866.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Bernadette's father worked on its construction and was present at its official opening, on Pentecost Sunday _____
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The basilica has a crypt, which was the first church to be completed in the sanctuary, in 1866. Bernadette's father worked on its construction and was present at its official opening, on Pentecost Sunday 1866.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Construction was started by Abbé _____ and bishop Laurence
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Construction was started by Abbé Peyramale and bishop Laurence.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The nave is small and a notable feature as are the enormous pillars which support the weight of the _____, which was constructed on top of it
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The nave is small and a notable feature as are the enormous pillars which support the weight of the Upper Basilica, which was constructed on top of it.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Peter, holding the Keys of the _____ of Heaven
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Peter, holding the Keys of the Kingdom of Heaven.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Opposite stands a statue of _____ walls of the corridor and nave are lined with small marble plaques, known as ex voto plaques, donated in thanks for spiritual favours received
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Opposite stands a statue of Pius X. The walls of the corridor and nave are lined with small marble plaques, called ex voto plaques, donated in thanks for spiritual favours received.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: It was consecrated in _____ and has a capacity of 1,500 worshipers
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: It was consecrated in 1901 and has a capacity of 1,500 worshipers.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The exterior of the dome is surmounted by a dramatic gilded crown and cross, which were a gift from the people of _____ in 1924
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The exterior of the dome is surmounted by a dramatic gilded crown and cross, which were a gift from the people of Ireland in 1924.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The exterior facade of the basilica was modified in _____ to include a depiction of the luminous mysteries, which are not a part of the traditional fifteen mysteries, but of an extended version of it
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The exterior facade of the basilica was modified in 2007 to include a depiction of the luminous mysteries, which are not a part of the traditional fifteen mysteries, but of an extended version of it by Pope John Paul II in 2002.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Pius X, known as the "_____", is the largest of the sanctuary's churches
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Pius X, called the "Underground Basilica", is the largest of the sanctuary's churches.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: It was designed by the architect Pierre Vago and completed in _____ in anticipation of the enormous crowds expected in Lourdes for the centenary of the apparitions
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: It was designed by the architect Pierre Vago and completed in 1958 in anticipation of the enormous crowds expected in Lourdes for the centenary of the apparitions.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: It was designed by the architect _____ and completed in 1958 in anticipation of the enormous crowds expected in Lourdes for the centenary of the apparitions
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: It was designed by the architect Pierre Vago and completed in 1958 in anticipation of the enormous crowds expected in Lourdes for the centenary of the apparitions.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: A modern, concrete building, it is almost entirely underground (part of the building lies beneath the _____ Père Rémi Sempé above)
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: A modern, concrete building, it is almost entirely underground (part of the building lies beneath the Boulevard Père Rémi Sempé above).

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: From _____ to 2018, the surroundings of the grotto were modified to facilitate the passing of pilgrims through the various facilities around the grotto
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: From 2014 to 2018, the surroundings of the grotto were modified to facilitate the passing of pilgrims through the various facilities around the grotto.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The recess of the grotto itself is undecorated, although a plain stone altar and lectern have been placed there so that _____ can be celebrated
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The recess of the grotto itself is undecorated, although a plain stone altar and lectern have been placed there so that Mass can be celebrated. During the pilgrimage season, two pilgrimage Masses are usually celebrated each morning at the grotto.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Above the main recess is the niche where the "lady" seen by _____ was standing during the apparitions and Fabisch's statue of Our Lady of Lourdes now stands
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Above the main recess is the niche where the "lady" seen by Bernadette Soubirous was standing during the apparitions and Fabisch's statue of Our Lady of Lourdes now stands.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: During the pilgrimage season, two pilgrimage _____ are usually celebrated each morning at the grotto
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: During the pilgrimage season, two pilgrimage Masses are usually celebrated each morning at the grotto.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The spring that _____ discovered can be seen at the rear of the grotto, shielded by a glass cover
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Above the main recess is the niche where the "lady" seen by Bernadette Soubirous was standing during the apparitions and Fabisch's statue of Our Lady of Lourdes now stands. The spring that Bernadette discovered can be seen at the rear of the grotto, shielded by a glass cover.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: One of the spots where _____ prayed to the Virgin is marked by a special paving slab
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: One of the spots where Bernadette prayed to the Virgin is marked by a special paving slab.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: This is also meant to repeat a gesture made by _____ during the apparitions as she washed herself with the water after she was told to do so by the "lady"
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: However, people in charge of the sanctuary thought it would be better to have two separate places for Lourdes water distribution, with one place available for drinking water and filling bottles and containers with water and another place intended for pilgrims to take water as a religious gesture, in the same way Bernadette Soubirous did during the apparitions when she was told by the "lady" to drink water from the spring and wash herself with it. This is also meant to repeat a gesture made by...

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: The original baths were built in _____ and the current baths in 1955
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: The original baths were built in 1862 and the current baths in 1955.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: They are located on the western side of the grotto along the _____ rock
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: They are located on the western side of the grotto along the Massabielle rock.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Pilgrims used to light candles near the grotto, along the _____ rock
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Pilgrims used to light candles near the grotto, along the Massabielle rock.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.question: Now they have to cross the _____ de Pau river on a new bridge to reach the "chapels of light", where all candles are meant to be lighted
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.fact: Now they have to cross the Gave de Pau river on a new bridge to reach the "chapels of light", where all candles are meant to be lighted.

Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subject: Important Days
Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes.subSubject: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
